summary: PR 2313 fixes the reproduced MLX architecture-resolution path and source-level Hunyuan shared-KV attention contract, but this Linux/gfx950 host cannot execute MLX/Metal. No real Hunyuan launch or token-equivalence result could be independently obtained.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of the original MLX architecture-resolution mechanism: the MLX case invoked get_model_architecture and raised the Hunyuan resolution error; two non-MLX boundary cases passed.
Independent reproduction against exact parent candidate 7bdae6c8: Hunyuan's fourth positional shared-KV argument raised TypeError.
At exact candidate 246dbf49, five CPU regressions passed for the MLX bypass and non-MLX/cached/fallback boundaries.
At exact candidate 246dbf49, Hunyuan's shared-KV positional argument routed to delegated decode while preserving return arity.
39 MLX attention tests collected but all skipped because mlx/Metal is unavailable; this is collection evidence, not runtime validation.
Candidate source compilation and patch whitespace integrity.

gpu_execution.evidence: The visible GPU is AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 under ROCm 7.2. MLX requires Apple Silicon/Metal, and importlib found no mlx module.

remaining_counterexamples: No independent end-to-end launch_server result exists for mlx-community/Hunyuan-7B-Instruct-4bit at candidate commit 246dbf49 because MLX/Metal and Apple Silicon are unavailable.
No independent real-model batched-decode token-equivalence result against mlx_lm exists at the candidate commit; the candidate's MLX tests all skipped on this host.
remaining_limitations: Linux x86_64 and AMD gfx950 cannot execute the Apple MLX/Metal backend.
Hunyuan model weights were not downloaded.
The tiny Llama transport fixture cannot validate Hunyuan architecture semantics and was not used as substitute evidence.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
